# Contributing

A4S is published for inspection, not as an open-contribution project.

Only the repository administrator, `pablontiv`, may open issues or pull requests.
The GitHub repository must keep both creation policies set to **Collaborators
only**. Unsolicited patches, feature requests, support requests, and pull
requests are not accepted.

For security reports, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and never disclose the
report in a public issue.

Unless a file or subdirectory says otherwise, the original A4S material is
`UNLICENSED`. Public access does not grant permission to copy, modify, or
redistribute it. See the repository `NOTICE` and the license notices attached to
specific imported or third-party artifacts.
